description: This file defines the AssetsTableConfigResolver class, which configures and resolves the entity table for assets in the application. It includes methods for setting up columns, actions, and data fetching logic specific to assets, with support for different asset scopes such as tenant, customer, and edge.

classes.name: AssetsTableConfigResolver
classes.description: Resolver class for configuring and managing the assets table, including data loading, column setup, and action handling based on asset scope.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves and configures the entity table for assets based on route parameters and user authority.

methods.name: configureColumns
methods.description: Configures table columns depending on the asset scope.

methods.name: configureEntityFunctions
methods.description: Sets up data fetching and delete functions based on asset scope.

methods.name: configureCellActions
methods.description: Defines cell-level actions for assets depending on scope.

methods.name: configureGroupActions
methods.description: Defines group actions for assets depending on scope.

methods.name: configureAddActions
methods.description: Defines header actions for adding assets depending on scope.

methods.name: openAsset
methods.description: Navigates to the asset detail page.

methods.name: addAssetsToCustomer
methods.description: Opens dialog to add assets to a customer.

methods.name: unassignFromCustomer
methods.description: Unassigns an asset from a customer.

methods.name: unassignAssetsFromCustomer
methods.description: Unassigns multiple assets from a customer.

methods.name: onAssetAction
methods.description: Handles specific asset actions triggered from the table.

methods.name: addAssetsToEdge
methods.description: Opens dialog to add assets to an edge.

methods.name: unassignFromEdge
methods.description: Unassigns an asset from an edge.

methods.name: unassignAssetsFromEdge
methods.description: Unassigns multiple assets from an edge.
